title: Build a static HTML page to spec
prompt: Create a static `index.html` file (vanilla HTML, no build step) that contains: a `<!DOCTYPE html>` declaration, an `<h1>` with the exact text "Shugu Eval", a `<ul>` with exactly three `<li>` items whose text is "alpha", "beta", "gamma" (in that order), and a `<button id="go">` whose text is "Go". The test file `verify.test.js` parses the file and checks this structure; make `node --test verify.test.js` pass. Do NOT modify the test file.
